g.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Segoe UI', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Loaded once per simulation while the core is idle,
GROWTH_TABLE, GROWTH_SHIFT (host): write the inactive bank
GROWTH_COMMIT: swap the banks at the next pass boundary
Cells with equal i² + j² form one class:
one pre-adder, one weight w[k] and one
Dashed corners lie outside the disk
Solid: engine datapath (eclk, one cell per cycle, every stage registered for 200 MHz).
Dashed arrows: host configuration paths (AXI4-Lite, aclk).
